description: Implementation of the TTSManager class handling Text-to-Speech functionalities, including configuration, speech control, access control, and event callbacks.

classes.name: TTS
classes.description: Namespace encapsulating the TTS (Text-to-Speech) management functionalities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new TTSManager instance with a specified event callback.

methods.name: enableTTS
methods.description: Enables or disables the TTS functionality.

methods.name: initiateDownload
methods.description: Starts the download process for fallback TTS resources.

methods.name: isTTSEnabled
methods.description: Checks if TTS is currently enabled.

methods.name: listVoices
methods.description: Lists available voices for a specified language or the current configuration.

methods.name: listLocalVoices
methods.description: Lists local voices for a specified language.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Updates the TTS configuration parameters.

methods.name: setFallbackText
methods.description: Sets fallback text data.

methods.name: setPrimaryVolDuck
methods.description: Sets primary volume ducking level.

methods.name: setAPIKey
methods.description: Sets the API key for TTS services.

methods.name: setACL
methods.description: Sets access control list for methods.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the current TTS configuration.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Initiates speech synthesis for given text.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses ongoing speech.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes paused speech.

methods.name: shut
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech.

methods.name: isSpeaking
methods.description: Checks if speech is currently ongoing.

methods.name: getSpeechState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of speech for a given ID.

methods.name: willSpeak
methods.description: Callback invoked before speech starts.

methods.name: started
methods.description: Callback invoked when speech starts.

methods.name: spoke
methods.description: Callback invoked when speech completes.

methods.name: paused
methods.description: Callback invoked when speech is paused.

methods.name: resumed
methods.description: Callback invoked when speech resumes.

methods.name: cancelled
methods.description: Callback invoked when speech is cancelled.

methods.name: interrupted
methods.description: Callback invoked when speech is interrupted.

methods.name: networkerror
methods.description: Callback invoked on network error during speech.

methods.name: playbackerror
methods.description: Callback invoked on playback error during speech.
